scripts.model: python3 blender/build_owl.py -- blender/owl_raw.glb blender/build_report.json && npx gltfpack -i blender/owl_raw.glb -o src/assets/strix.glb -cc -kn -km -kv -vpf -vn 10 -vtf && npx gltfpack -i blender/owl_raw.glb -o src/assets/strix-plain.glb -kn -km -kv -vpf -vn 10 -vtf -si 0.6 && rm blender/owl_raw.glb
scripts.build:hosted: tsc --noEmit && VITE_GLB_FALLBACK=strix-plain.glb VITE_GLB_JSON=1 vite build --outDir dist-hosted && cp src/assets/strix-plain.glb dist-hosted/assets/ && node tools/embed-glb.mjs dist-hosted/assets
